- **Gray_Mold**: Gray fluffy growth on fruit/microscopic spores — not a petri dish match

The two petri dishes showing white cottony mycelium with dark sclerotia forming at the periphery is the textbook culture appearance of *Sclerotinia sclerotiorum*, the causal agent of Sclerotinia Timber Rot.
